title: A6 black point range k 0.25 -> 0.12 (measured 10.8% crush at bp=+100, was 44.7%)

commit.merge_subject: merge: A6 black point range k 0.25 -> 0.12 (measured 10.8% crush at bp=+100, was 44.7%)

description:
Guide A6, owner request 2026-11-23. Stage 9 (black point) used
lift = -0.25 * bp/100 in linear light, so bp = +100 subtracted 0.25
linear (~half of display brightness) and crushed 44.7% of night-frame
pixels fully black — the owner's saved bp=+100 grade looked "dead".
The slider's -100..+100 range and semantics stay; only k shrinks.

Measured by bp_measure on the two night fixtures (261110_004150,
261110_004208, frames 0 and mid; black% = pixels fully black at
display after OETF+clamp+quantize, mean = display luma 0-255;
averages over 4 measured frames):

  k      bp         black%       mean
  neutral (k=0)      0.0%       101.2
  0.25    +100      44.7%       26.2
  0.12    +100      10.8%       59.0
  0.08    +100       3.8%       73.3
  0.12     +50       2.0%       80.7
  0.25    -100       0.0%      157.2
  0.12    -100       0.0%      131.8

Chosen k = 0.12: bp=+100 crushes 10.8%
changed: test: bp_measure tool sweeps A6 black-point k on night fixtures
fix: shrink black point range k=0.25 -> 0.12 (A6, owner decision 2026-11-23)
